description: This is a PHP source file defining the Importer class, which manages data import operations into SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It handles parsing input data, data sanitization, validation, duplicate checking, mapping, saving records, error handling, and relationship management during import processes.

classes.name: Importer
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the import process, including data parsing, sanitization, validation, saving records, duplicate detection, error handling, and relationship management during the import into the CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Importer with import source data and target bean, setting up configurations, validation, and import-related properties.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Iterates over import source rows and processes each row; optionally saves mapping configuration.

methods.name: importRow
methods.description: Processes an individual row of import data, performing field mapping, validation, duplication checks, and saving the record.

methods.name: sanitizeFieldValueByType
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates a field value based on its declared type.

methods.name: cloneExistingBean
methods.description: Clones an existing bean record, used for record updates or duplication handling.

methods.name: removeDeletedBean
methods.description: Deletes a bean record from the database when it is marked as deleted.

methods.name: saveImportBean
methods.description: Saves a bean record to the database, setting default and related data, and invoking pre/post save logic.

methods.name: saveMappingFile
methods.description: Saves column mappings and default values to a mapping profile.

methods.name: populateDefaultMapValue
methods.description: Generates default values for fields, applying necessary format conversions.

methods.name: getImportColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the list of importable fields based on user-selected columns.

methods.name: getFieldSanitizer
methods.description: Creates and configures a field sanitizer object with locale and currency settings.

methods.name: setFieldKeyTranslator
methods.description: Sets a mapping from CRM field keys to external data source keys.

methods.name: _undoCreatedBeans
methods.description: Deletes beans that were created during import if an error occurs or need to rollback.

methods.name: _convertId
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts IDs to a safe format.

methods.name: retrieveAdvancedMapping
methods.description: Retrieves advanced mapping and duplicate detection settings from request data.

methods.name: getImportableModules
methods.description: Lists modules available for import based on existing bean classes and import capability.

methods.name: handleImportErrors
methods.description: Static method to handle and log PHP errors during import, with control over fatal errors.

methods.name: checkRelatedIDsAfterSave
methods.description: Ensures related parent and child relationships are properly set after record save.

calls: logic for handling bean relationship loading and addition
Various helper functions for formatting and validation
